profile.headline: Software Engineer, Apple
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Software Engineer who enjoys building exciting features in user facing iOS & Mac apps. Passionate about mentoring students, and interested in growing as an engineer and engineering leader.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Podcasts (NYC)
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Development Engineer III
positions.description: Skills: iOS Development · C++ · iOS · Git · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Objective-C

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
- Developer on Adobe Fresco, a drawing and painting mobile application, and shipped numerous features in the 1.0, 1.x and 2.0 releases developing in Objective-C, and in C++.
- Implemented Fresco’s dark mode support for iOS12+, one iOS earlier than Apple.
- Frequently worked on shared UI features for use by other product    
   teams, like Photoshop for iPad and Aero.
- Fixed bugs, gave/received code review feedback, integrated components and frameworks from other teams, collaborated with designers and product managers. The usual.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant, Department of Computer and Information Sciences
positions.description:
- Assisted faculty members with classroom instruction, exams, and curriculum development for three introductory computer science course sections. 
- Effectively explained C++, object-oriented programming, algorithms, and data structures topics to students in class and during office hours.
- Mentored students seeking internship and full-time opportunities and provided technical interview preparation.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant, Department of Computer and Information Sciences
positions.description:
- Assisted faculty members with classroom instruction, exams, and grading for three introductory computer science course sections. 
-Effectively explained C++  topics to students in class and during office hours.

honors.title: Forbes 30 Under 30 Summit Scholar
honors.description: The Scholars Program, focused on diversity and inclusion, invites 1,000 college students to the Forbes 30 Under 30 Summit in Boston.

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Lead successful technical design, fundraising, community outreach, and construction of student chapter project to build fish farms for villages in Serere District, Uganda.
- Monitored sustainable and profitable use of our first fish pond in Omorio Village, Uganda.
- Organized and led the first NYC Mini-Conference for professional and student EWB-USA chapters.

http://fordhamewb.org/

https://www.ewb-usa.org/teach-a-community-to-build-a-fish-pond/

volunteerExperiences.role: Vice President of Fordham University Chapter
volunteerExperiences.description:
- Facilitated progress of chapter project to build a series of fish farms for villages in Omorio, Uganda.
- Planned and taught educational science experiments for differing grade levels of CitySquash students in the Bronx, and coordinated EWB volunteers to do the same.
